facts.business: DroneAcharya Aerial Innovations Limited is an integrated drone technology company operating across drone manufacturing, pilot training, aerial and geospatial services, defence and enterprise solutions, R&D, data processing, and technology partnerships.

segments.name: Drone pilot and technical training (DGCA-approved RPTOS)
Aerial surveying, mapping, inspection and geospatial data services
Drone data processing and GIS solutions
R&D in autonomous, surveillance and industrial drone applications

guidance_or_targets.statement: Focus on improving quality of revenue, increasing utilisation of existing capabilities, improving gross margins, strengthening working-capital discipline and converting business pipeline into executable revenue
guidance_or_targets.metric: Revenue quality, utilisation, gross margins, working capital, pipeline conversion

key_risks: Delays and disruptions in execution of business opportunities and timing of procurement/customer deliveries
Dependence on specialised electronic components, sensors, batteries, communication equipment sourced through international supply chains
Global geopolitical developments and supply-chain disruptions affecting component availability, pricing and logistics
Selective approach to project execution may limit near-term revenue
